title: Acme Corp FY2025 Annual Overview
content: Acme Corporation is a fictional industrial-software company used for Horus performance benchmarking. In fiscal year 2025 Acme reported total annual revenue of 482 million dollars, up from 410 million dollars in fiscal year 2024, a year-over-year growth rate of 17.6 percent. The company operates three business segments: Industrial Automation, Cloud Platform, and Professional Services. Industrial Automation remained the largest segment at 248 million dollars of revenue. Cloud Platform was the fastest growing segment, expanding 41 percent to 144 million dollars. Professional Services contributed 90 million dollars. Gross margin for the full year was 63 percent, and the company ended the year with 1,920 employees across nine countries.

title: Acme Corp Q4 FY2025 Results
content: In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025 Acme Corporation reported quarterly revenue of 138 million dollars, compared with 121 million dollars in the third quarter, a sequential increase of 14 percent, and compared with 109 million dollars in the fourth quarter of the prior year, a year-over-year increase of 26.6 percent. Q4 was the strongest quarter in the company's history. Cloud Platform bookings in Q4 reached 52 million dollars. Operating income in Q4 was 22 million dollars, for an operating margin of 15.9 percent. Free cash flow in the quarter was 18 million dollars. The Q4 dollar-based net revenue retention rate was 119 percent.

title: Acme Corp Key Operating Metrics FY2025
content: Acme Corporation tracks several key operating metrics. Annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached 196 million dollars at fiscal year end, up 38 percent year over year. The company served 3,140 active enterprise customers, of which 412 contributed more than 100,000 dollars of ARR each. Dollar-based net revenue retention was 119 percent. Gross revenue retention was 94 percent. The average sales cycle was 74 days. Customer acquisition cost payback was 14 months. The Rule of 40 score, combining the 17.6 percent growth rate and the 24 percent free-cash-flow margin, was 41.6. Monthly active users of the Cloud Platform averaged 88,000.

title: Acme Corp Regional Revenue Breakdown FY2025
content: Acme Corporation's fiscal year 2025 revenue was distributed across three regions. North America generated 268 million dollars, representing 55.6 percent of total revenue and growing 12 percent year over year. Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) generated 134 million dollars, representing 27.8 percent of total revenue and growing 23 percent. Asia Pacific (APAC) generated 80 million dollars, representing 16.6 percent of total revenue and growing 34 percent, making it the fastest-growing region. The company opened new sales offices in Singapore and Munich during the year to support international expansion.

title: Acme Corp FY2025 Risk Disclosures
content: Acme Corporation disclosed several risk factors in its fiscal year 2025 report. First, customer concentration risk: the ten largest customers accounted for 21 percent of total revenue. Second, foreign-exchange risk from growing EMEA and APAC revenue exposed earnings to currency fluctuation. Third, competition risk in the Cloud Platform segment from larger incumbent vendors with broader product portfolios. Fourth, talent-retention risk in a tight engineering labor market, with voluntary attrition at 11 percent. Fifth, supply-chain risk affecting the hardware components used in the Industrial Automation segment, which extended average lead times to 16 weeks.
